help.title: Help & Resources
help.gettingStartedContent:
1. Connect your Salesforce org using the Organizations page.
2. Open the Monitor to check your org health.
3. Use Seed to generate test data in your sandbox.
4. Set up Sync to keep environments in sync.
5. Explore Compare, DataOps, and Automation for advanced workflows.
help.monitorContent:
The Monitor dashboard shows real-time org health:
- Health Score gauge with contributing factors
- API limits with usage trends and predictions
- Active and recent Apex jobs
- Alert notifications for critical thresholds

Tip: Enable auto-refresh for continuous monitoring.
help.seedContent:
The Seed wizard generates realistic test data:
1. Select your target org
2. Choose objects to seed
3. Configure field rules (AI, Faker, static, sequence...)
4. Set up relationships and volumes
5. Review and execute

Tip: Use AI generation for the most realistic data.
help.syncContent:
Sync data between two Salesforce orgs:
- Full sync only: every run replays the whole object set (incremental, delta and CDC are not implemented)
- Auto field mapping with confidence scores
- 13 transform types for data manipulation
- Conflict resolution strategies
- Rollback support for safe operations
help.compareContent:
Compare metadata between two orgs:
- Diff viewer grouped by category and risk level
- Permission matrix comparison
- Drift detection dashboard
- Impact analysis graph
- Deploy directly from diff results
help.dataopsContent:
Complete data operations suite:
- Backup & Restore with scheduling
- GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA anonymization
- Data quality scanning with 7 rule types
- Mass delete and storage optimization
- Data Subject Request (DSR) management
help.automationContent:
Visual pipeline builder for automation:
- 15 step types across 4 categories
- 6 trigger types including schedules and webhooks
- Conditional routing with 11 operators
- Execution history and success rate tracking
- Pipeline templates for quick setup
help.aiContent:
AI Assistant, with your own Anthropic key:
- Chat, and NL2SOQL, custom personas and AI field rules in Seed
- Pipeline drafts in Automation
- While AI is on, a failed Seed, Sync, DataOps or Automation run sends its error message to the model for a fix suggestion, unless a built-in table already answers its error code
- Compare's schema advice and Monitor's anomaly scan are rule-based: they run with AI off and no key
- Configure your API key in Settings > AI
help.shortcutsContent:
Ctrl+1..9/0 — Jump to a module (Monitor, Seed, Sync, Compare, DataOps, Automation, Grappe, Autopilot, Migration, Forge)
G + letter — Quick navigation (e.g. G then F for Forge)
Ctrl+K — Command palette
Ctrl+Enter — Run the current action
Escape — Close modals and dialogs
Tab — Navigate between elements
Enter/Space — Activate buttons and links
help.faqContent:
Q: Why is my Health Score low?
A: Check API limit usage, failed jobs, and storage consumption. The score weighs multiple factors.

Q: How to fix timeout errors?
A: Increase API timeout in Settings > Advanced. For large datasets, enable Grappe mode.

Q: Can I undo a sync operation?
A: Yes, enable Rollback before executing. SandForge creates a restore point.

Q: How do I connect a production org safely?
A: Production orgs are auto-detected and marked as Critical safety tier. All destructive operations require confirmation.
help.troubleshootingContent:
Connection Issues:
- Verify your Salesforce credentials are valid
- Check your IP whitelist settings
- Ensure your session has not expired

Performance Issues:
- Enable Grappe mode for large datasets
- Increase API timeout in Settings > Advanced
- Reduce batch size for complex operations

Data Issues:
- Verify field-level security (FLS) permissions
- Check for required fields that may be missing
- Review governor limits in Monitor dashboard
